Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} antitribu hold that their clan was once composed of knights and statesmen who, after the Anarch Revolt, evolved with the changing times - only to watch their elders tighten their grip on power and deny younger Ventrue their due. Rejecting the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}'s path as a disgrace, the Crusaders fight tirelessly to pave the way for Caine's childer, believing Cainites must one day dominate humanity as instruments of a greater destiny.

Disciplines: Dominate, Fortitude, Presence

Advantage: Their passionate dedication has earned the Ventrue antitribu a powerful reputation; at the start of the game, each gains one Sabbat Status Trait at no cost from Respected, Righteous, Passionate, or Feared. Coming from hale, capable stock, a Ventrue antitribu player may also take one free Ability from Academics, Finance, Leadership, Melee, or Politics during character creation.

Disadvantage: Like their Camarilla counterparts, Sabbat Ventrue suffer a selective feeding restriction and may only take blood meeting the requirements of their particular prey group (though they may still Embrace normally). Ventrue antitribu also begin play with one less Blood Trait than other vampires of their generation.

Organization: Ventrue antitribu see themselves as the vanguard of a coming Cainite order, often taking command roles within packs and pushing the sect toward disciplined, purposeful action.
